sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Antique Enthusiast is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hey, brother! There's only one true connoisseur left in all of Tarkov. My favorite client! And now he's decided it's time to expand his collection. He's looking for antique vases and teapots. Between you and me, I can understand the vases, but why anyone would need that many collectible teapots is beyond me... Still, an order's an order, and he pays well. Everything has to be found by your own hand, as pristine as antiques can possibly be, so get out there and track them down yourself."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with Ragman to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 3 Antique teapots in raid
- Find 3 Antique vases in raid
- Find 2 Axel parrot figurines in raid
- Find 2 Raven figurines in raid
- Find 5 Gold skull rings in raid
- Hand over 3 Antique teapots to Ragman
- Hand over 3 Antique vases to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Axel parrot figurines to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Raven figurines to Ragman
- Hand over 5 Gold skull rings to Ragman

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- +4 Charisma skill levels
- Ragman Rep +1.5
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- Unlocks barter for Granit Br4 ballistic plate at Ragman LL4
- Unlocks Bricks Hideout wall style
- Unlocks White ceiling Hideout ceiling style
"Do you have it? Great. I wonder what's he gonna ask next time, a diamond-coated toilet? But hey, if he does ask for it, you actually will have to look for it. Thanks for the help, brother."
